title: Out-of-Order Queue Inter-Engine Barrier (Copy to Compute)
prompt: Provide a SYCL C++ snippet demonstrating dual queue asynchronous execution: `copy_queue` performs an asynchronous memory copy from host to device, and `compute_queue` waits for the copy completion using an event barrier without blocking the host CPU thread.
target_invariant: Compute queue submission must declare depends_on(copy_event); neither queue may invoke blocking wait() on host.
